IonQ has demonstrated a real‑time quantum error–decoding algorithm that runs on a single commercial CPU, completing 31.5 million operations without delay. The demonstration, reported by Pulse Two, illustrates the feasibility of integrating classical processing for error correction in near‑term quantum systems. This event highlights IonQ’s progress toward scalable, fault‑tolerant quantum computing.
